description: Strict Ca2+-ligand retention scoring for B9 domains vs Ca2+-dependent and Ca2+-independent C2 domains
code:
import requests, time, json, numpy as np, pandas as pd
from scipy import stats
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
AA3={'ALA':'A','ARG':'R','ASN':'N','ASP':'D','CYS':'C','GLN':'Q','GLU':'E','GLY':'G','HIS':'H',
'ILE':'I','LEU':'L','LYS':'K','MET':'M','PHE':'F','PRO':'P','SER':'S','THR':'T','TRP':'W','TYR':'Y','VAL':'V','MSE':'M'}
CHG={'D':-1,'E':-1,'K':1,'R':1}
def parse_pdb(text):
    chains={}; ions=[]; seen=set()
    for line in text.splitlines():
        rec=line[:6]
        if rec in ('ATOM  ','HETATM'):
            if line[16] not in (' ','A'): continue
            resn=line[17:20].strip(); ch=line[21]; num=line[22:27].strip(); name=line[12:16].strip()
            try: x,y,z=float(line[30:38]),float(line[38:46]),float(line[46:54])
            except: continue
            if resn in AA3 and (rec=='ATOM  ' or resn=='MSE'):
                k=(ch,num)
                if k not in seen:
                    seen.add(k); chains.setdefault(ch,[]).append({'resn':resn,'num':num,'atoms':{}})
                chains[ch][-1]['atoms'][name]=np.array([x,y,z])
            elif rec=='HETATM' and resn in ('CA','MG','MN') and name==resn:
                ions.append({'el':resn,'num':num,'xyz':np.array([x,y,z])})
    return chains, ions
def seq_of(r): return ''.join(AA3.get(x['resn'],'X') for x in r)
def best_offset(cs, ts):
    best=(-1,0,0)
    for off in range(len(cs)):
        if len(cs)-off < min(len(ts),20): break
        m=n=0
        for i,c in enumerate(ts):
            k=off+i
            if k>=len(cs): break
            n+=1; m+=(cs[k]==c)
        if m>best[0]: best=(m,off,n)
    return best
def kabsch(P,Q):
    H=(P-P.mean(0)).T@(Q-Q.mean(0)); U,S,Vt=np.linalg.svd(H)
    R=Vt.T@np.diag([1,1,np.sign(np.linalg.det(Vt.T@U.T))])@U.T
    return R, Q.mean(0)-R@P.mean(0)
def foldseek_hits(pdbtext):
    r=requests.post('https://search.foldseek.com/api/ticket',files={'q':('q.pdb',pdbtext)},
        data={'mode':'3diaa','database[]':['pdb100']},timeout=120); tk=r.json()['id']
    for i in range(45):
        s=requests.get(f'https://search.foldseek.com/api/ticket/{tk}',timeout=60).json()
        if s.get('status') in ('COMPLETE','ERROR'): break
        time.sleep(8)
    al=requests.get(f'https://search.foldseek.com/api/result/{tk}/0',timeout=180).json()['results'][0]['alignments']
    if al and isinstance(al[0],list): al=al[0]
    d={}
    for h in al: d.setdefault(h['target'][:4].upper(),[]).append(h)
    return {k:sorted(v,key=lambda x:x['eval'])[0] for k,v in d.items()}
CACHE={}
def get_pdb(pid):
    if pid not in CACHE: CACHE[pid]=requests.get(f'https://files.rcsb.org/download/{pid}.pdb',timeout=90).text
    return CACHE[pid]
def map_target(h,qres,pid):
    chains,ions=parse_pdb(get_pdb(pid)); tseq=h['tSeq']; bc=None;bf=-1
    for ch,res in chains.items():
        cs=seq_of(res); m,off,n=best_offset(cs,tseq)
        if n>=min(len(tseq),30) and m/max(1,n)>bf: bf=m/max(1,n); bc=(ch,off)
    if bc is None or bf<0.8: return None
    ch,off=bc; tres=chains[ch]; qa,ta=h['qAln'],h['dbAln']; qi=h['qStartPos']-1; ti=h['dbStartPos']-1
    P=[];Q=[];pairs=[]
    for a,b in zip(qa,ta):
        if a!='-' and b!='-':
            k=off+ti
            if qi<len(qres) and k<len(tres) and 'CA' in qres[qi]['atoms'] and 'CA' in tres[k]['atoms']:
                P.append(tres[k]['atoms']['CA']); Q.append(qres[qi]['atoms']['CA']); pairs.append((qi,k))
        if a!='-': qi+=1
        if b!='-': ti+=1
    P=np.array(P);Q=np.array(Q)
    if len(P)<25: return None
    idx=np.arange(len(P))
    for _ in range(5):
        R,t=kabsch(P[idx],Q[idx]); d=np.linalg.norm((P@R.T+t)-Q,axis=1); idx=np.where(d<4.0)[0]
        if len(idx)<15: break
    R,t=kabsch(P[idx],Q[idx]); d=np.linalg.norm((P@R.T+t)-Q,axis=1)
    return dict(R=R,t=t,rmsd=float(np.sqrt((d[idx]**2).mean())),ncore=len(idx),tres=tres,ions=ions,pairs=pairs)

def strict_metrics(res, site, r=8.0):
    """count only Asp/Glu carboxylate oxygens; also basic N within r"""
    nO=0; dres=[]; basics=[]; chg=0
    for rr in res:
        aa=AA3.get(rr['resn'],'X'); hit=False
        for an,xyz in rr['atoms'].items():
            dd=np.linalg.norm(xyz-site)
            if dd<r:
                if (aa=='D' and an in ('OD1','OD2')) or (aa=='E' and an in ('OE1','OE2')):
                    nO+=1; hit=True
                if (aa=='K' and an=='NZ') or (aa=='R' and an in ('NH1','NH2','NE')):
                    if aa+rr['num'] not in basics: basics.append(aa+rr['num'])
        if hit: dres.append(aa+rr['num'])
        ca=rr['atoms'].get('CA')
        if ca is not None and np.linalg.norm(ca-site)<12: chg+=CHG.get(aa,0)
    return dict(carboxylO_8A=nO, acidic_res_8A=dres, basic_res_8A=basics, netcharge_12A=chg)

CA_REFS=['7JOF','1A25','1W15','5A52']
rows=[]
QUERIES={'B9D2 (human)':'Q9BPU9','B9D1 (human)':'Q9UPM9','MKS1 (human)':'Q9NXB0'}
qstore={}
for qname,acc in QUERIES.items():
    j=requests.get(f'https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/api/prediction/{acc}',timeout=60).json()[0]
    qpdb=requests.get(j['pdbUrl'],timeout=120).text
    qres=parse_pdb(qpdb)[0]['A']
    hits=foldseek_hits(qpdb)
    sites=[];rms=[]
    for pid in CA_REFS:
        h=hits.get(pid)
        if not h: continue
        m=map_target(h,qres,pid)
        if not m: continue
        rms.append(m['rmsd'])
        tca=np.array([x['atoms']['CA'] for x in m['tres'] if 'CA' in x['atoms']])
        for ion in m['ions']:
            if np.min(np.linalg.norm(tca-ion['xyz'],axis=1))>10: continue
            nl=sum(1 for x in m['tres'] for an,xyz in x['atoms'].items() if an.startswith('O') and np.linalg.norm(xyz-ion['xyz'])<3.3)
            if nl>=3: sites.append(m['R']@ion['xyz']+m['t'])
    sites=np.array(sites)
    keep=[i for i,s in enumerate(sites) if (np.linalg.norm(sites-s,axis=1)<6).sum()>=2]
    cons=sites[keep].mean(0)
    met=strict_metrics(qres,cons)
    qstore[qname]=dict(res=qres,site=cons,seq=seq_of(qres),rms=rms)
    rows.append(dict(structure=qname,group='B9 domain (AlphaFold model)',rmsd=round(np.mean(rms),2),**met))

b9=qstore['B9D2 (human)']
hitsB9=foldseek_hits(requests.get(requests.get('https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/api/prediction/Q9BPU9',timeout=60).json()[0]['pdbUrl'],timeout=120).text)
PANEL=[('7JOF','Ca2+-dependent C2','Dysferlin C2A'),('1A25','Ca2+-dependent C2','PKCbeta C2'),
       ('1W15','Ca2+-dependent C2','Synaptotagmin-4 C2B'),('5A52','Ca2+-dependent C2','Arabidopsis CAR1 C2'),
       ('6EEL','Ca2+-dependent C2','Myoferlin C2A'),('6NYC','Ca2+-dependent C2','Munc13-1 C2B'),
       ('7AS6','Ca2+-dependent C2','Plant E-Syt1 C2A'),('2ISD','Ca2+-dependent C2','PLCdelta1 C2'),
       ('1GMI','Ca2+-independent C2','PKCepsilon C2'),('2NQ3','Ca2+-independent C2','Itch C2'),
       ('5VLR','Ca2+-independent C2','PI3Kdelta C2')]
for pid,grp,lab in PANEL:
    h=hitsB9.get(pid)
    if not h: continue
    m=map_target(h,b9['res'],pid)
    if not m: continue
    tres=[{'resn':x['resn'],'num':x['num'],'atoms':{k:(m['R']@v+m['t']) for k,v in x['atoms'].items()}} for x in m['tres']]
    met=strict_metrics(tres,b9['site'])
    rows.append(dict(structure=f"{lab} ({pid})",group=grp,rmsd=round(m['rmsd'],2),**met))
df=pd.DataFrame(rows)
print(df[['structure','group','rmsd','carboxylO_8A','netcharge_12A']].to_string(index=False))
print()
for _,r in df.iterrows():
    print(f"{r['structure']:30s} acidic@site={r['acidic_res_8A']}  basic@site={r['basic_res_8A']}")
dep=df[df.group=='Ca2+-dependent C2'].carboxylO_8A.values
ind=df[df.group=='Ca2+-independent C2'].carboxylO_8A.values
b9v=df[df.group.str.startswith('B9')].carboxylO_8A.values
u,p=stats.mannwhitneyu(dep,b9v,alternative='greater')
print(f"\nCarboxylate O within 8 A of Ca2+ site I: Ca-dependent C2 median={np.median(dep)} (n={len(dep)}, {sorted(dep)}), "
      f"B9 domains={sorted(b9v)}, Ca-independent C2={sorted(ind)}")
print(f"Mann-Whitney (Ca-dependent > B9): U={u}, p={p:.4f}")
u2,p2=stats.mannwhitneyu(dep,ind,alternative='greater'); print(f"Mann-Whitney (Ca-dependent > Ca-independent): U={u2}, p={p2:.4f}")
df.to_csv('/tmp/panel.csv',index=False)

# ---- figure ----
fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(13,5.2))
ax=axes[0]
colors={'Ca2+-dependent C2':'#2b6cb0','Ca2+-independent C2':'#dd8452','B9 domain (AlphaFold model)':'#c53030'}
d2=df.sort_values(['group','carboxylO_8A'])
ax.barh(range(len(d2)), d2.carboxylO_8A, color=[colors[g] for g in d2.group])
ax.set_yticks(range(len(d2))); ax.set_yticklabels(d2.structure, fontsize=9)
ax.set_xlabel('Asp/Glu carboxylate oxygens within 8 A of C2 Ca2+ site I')
ax.set_title('Ca2+-ligand retention after structural superposition', fontsize=11)
for i,g in enumerate(colors): ax.scatter([],[],color=colors[g],label=g,marker='s')
ax.legend(fontsize=8, loc='lower right')
ax.grid(axis='x', alpha=.3)

ax=axes[1]
grps=[('Ca2+-dependent\nC2 (n=%d)'%len(dep),dep,'#2b6cb0'),('Ca2+-independent\nC2 (n=%d)'%len(ind),ind,'#dd8452'),
      ('B9 domains\n(n=%d)'%len(b9v),b9v,'#c53030')]
for i,(nm,v,c) in enumerate(grps):
    ax.scatter(np.random.normal(i,0.06,len(v)), v, color=c, s=70, zorder=3)
    ax.hlines(np.median(v), i-0.25, i+0.25, color='k', lw=2, zorder=4)
ax.set_xticks(range(3)); ax.set_xticklabels([g[0] for g in grps], fontsize=9)
ax.set_ylabel('carboxylate O within 8 A of Ca2+ site I')
ax.set_title('B9 domains resemble Ca2+-independent C2 domains\n(Mann-Whitney dep > B9: p=%.3f)'%p, fontsize=11)
ax.grid(axis='y', alpha=.3)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
